title: Adi-khanda, part 12 (portion 20)
html:
Banga-vijaya: the Ganga, loving the Lord, rises to touch His feet; a brahmana devoted to the Ganga recognizes Him as Bhagavan and tells how the Ganga was born from the Lord, who melted at Shiva's singing; the Lord journeys to East Bengal, sanctifies the Padmavati and gives the name of Hari to all; Lakshmi serves Shachi in Navadvipa

Kaishora-lila (The Pastimes of Youth): Banga-vijaya — the Lord in East Bengal

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. One day, when Sri Sri Mahaprabhu went at sunset to see the Ganga, Ganga-devi, seeing her beloved Lord, surged up in love and tenderly began to touch His feet again and again. The acharyas, mishras, bhattas and other brahmana pandits who at that time, having finished their evening prayers on the bank of the Ganga, were praising the Ganga, were astonished to see the water suddenly rise and fell to pondering; and then a certain brahmana devoted to the Ganga, by her grace, came to know that the Lord is Bhagavan Himself. In explaining the cause of this rising of the water the author relates a Puranic story: once the devarshi Narada, together with Mahadeva and Ganesha, was singing the glories of Sri Hari, and at that time Bhagavan Sri Hari Himself appeared there. The perspiration that then came out on His divine body as He heard the kirtana about Himself is the Ganga, Brahman in liquid form. […] Then Bhagavan Gaurahari wished to go to East Bengal […]; having shown boundless mercy to the people of East Bengal, He returned to Navadvipa, but before that Lakshmi-devi, bitten by the serpent of separation from the Lord, disappeared from this world. Therefore Shachi-devi […]; and Gaurahari, consoling His mother, […].1

Raga shri;2 disha: "How wondrous — behold: the Darling of Navadvipa, dear as life — are haya!"

আর দিনে এক কথা শুন সর্বজন ।
বিশ্বম্ভর-গুণগাথা নিতুই নূতন ॥ ১ ॥

āra dine eka kathā śuna sarbajana |
biśbambhara-guṇagāthā nitui nūtana || 1 ||

ara dine eka katha — another story; shuna sarvajana — listen, everyone; vishvambhara-guna-gatha — the song of Vishvambhara's virtues; nitui nutana — ever new

1Listen, everyone, to another story:
the song of Vishvambhara's virtues is ever new.

গঙ্গা দেখিবারে গেলা বয়স্যের মেলা ।
দিন-অবসানে সন্ধ্যা হৈল রম্য বেলা ॥ ২ ॥

gaṅgā dekhibāre gelā baẏasyera melā |
dina-abasāne sandhyā haila ramya belā || 2 ||

ganga dekhibare gela — went to see the Ganga; vayasyera mela — with a band of friends; dina-avasane — at the end of the day; sandhya haila ramya bela — the lovely evening hour came

2[He] went with His friends to see the Ganga;
the day was ending, the lovely evening hour had come.

গঙ্গার দুকূলে যত ব্রাহ্মণ-সজ্জন ।
গঙ্গা নমস্করি নিতি করয়ে স্তবন ॥ ৩ ॥

gaṅgāra dukūle yata brāhmaṇa-sajjana |
gaṅgā namaskari niti karaẏe stabana || 3 ||

gangara dukule — on both banks of the Ganga; yata brahmana-sajjana — all the brahmanas and good people; ganga namaskari — bowing to the Ganga; niti karaye stavana — offer praises as daily

3On both banks of the Ganga all the brahmanas and good people,
bowing to the Ganga, were offering her praises as every day.

কাখে কুম্ভ করি যায় পুরনারীগণ ।
নিরিখয়ে গঙ্গাদেবী বেকত-বদন ॥ ৪ ॥

kākhe kumbha kari yāẏa puranārīgaṇa |
nirikhaẏe gaṅgādebī bekata-badana || 4 ||

kakhe kumbha kari — with pitchers on their hips; yaya puranarigana — the townswomen go; nirikhaye gangadevi — gaze at the goddess Ganga; bekata-badana — with faces unveiled

4With pitchers on their hips the townswomen go
and, faces unveiled, gaze at the goddess Ganga.

মিশ্র আচার্য ভট্ট পণ্ডিত অপার ।
কত কত ধর্মশীল উত্তম-আচার ॥ ৫ ॥

miśra ācārya bhaṭṭa paṇḍita apāra |
kata kata dharmaśīla uttama-ācāra || 5 ||

mishra acharya bhatta pandita apara — countless mishras, acharyas, bhattas, pandits; kata kata dharmashila — so many pious people; uttama-achara — of excellent conduct

5Countless mishras, acharyas, bhattas and pandits,
so many pious people of excellent conduct —

সর্বজন দাণ্ডাইয়া দেখে গঙ্গাকূলে ।
গঙ্গার নির্মল জল শোভে নানা ফুলে ॥ ৬ ॥

sarbajana dāṇḍāiẏā dekhe gaṅgākūle |
gaṅgāra nirmala jala śobhe nānā phule || 6 ||

sarvajana dandaiya — all, standing; dekhe ganga-kule — gaze on the bank of the Ganga; gangara nirmala jala — the pure water of the Ganga; shobhe nana phule — is adorned with many flowers

6all stand on the bank of the Ganga and gaze at her:
the pure waters of the Ganga are adorned with many flowers.

গন্ধ চন্দন মাল্য দিব্য কদলক ।
যুবক যুবতী বৃদ্ধ পূজয়ে বালক ॥ ৭ ॥

gandha candana mālya dibya kadalaka |
yubaka yubatī bṛddha pūjaẏe bālaka || 7 ||

gandha chandana malya — with scents, sandal, garlands; divya kadalaka — fine bananas; yuvaka yuvati vriddha — young men, young women, the old; pujaye balaka — and children worship

7With scents, sandal, garlands and fine bananas
young men and women, the old and children worship her.

ত্রৈলোক্যপাবনী গঙ্গা বহে মহাবেগে ।
আপনা না ধরে গঙ্গা প্রভু-অনুরাগে ॥ ৮ ॥

trailokyapābanī gaṅgā bahe mahābege |
āpanā nā dhare gaṅgā prabhu-anurāge || 8 ||

trailokya-pavani ganga — the Ganga, purifier of the three worlds; bahe mahavege — flows swiftly; apana na dhare ganga — the Ganga cannot contain herself; prabhu-anurage — in love for the Lord

8The Ganga, purifier of the three worlds, flows swiftly:
in her love for the Lord the Ganga cannot contain herself.

উথলিল গঙ্গাদেবী বাঢ়িল সলিল ।
কুলু কুলু শব্দে পহুঁ-অঙ্গ পরশিল ॥ ৯ ॥

uthalila gaṅgādebī bāṛhila salila |
kulu kulu śabde pahuṁ-aṅga paraśila || 9 ||

uthalila gangadevi — the goddess Ganga surged; badhila salila — the waters rose; kulu kulu shabde — with a murmur; pahun-anga parashila — touched the Lord's body

9The goddess Ganga surged up, her waters rose,
and with a murmur she touched the Lord's body.

পুনঃ পরশের আশে বাঢ়ে গঙ্গাদেবী ।
সন্দেহ লাগিল লোকে মনে মনে ভাবি ॥ ১০ ॥

punaḥ paraśera āśe bāṛhe gaṅgādebī |
sandeha lāgila loke mane mane bhābi || 10 ||

punah parashera ashe — longing to touch again; badhe gangadevi — the goddess Ganga rises; sandeha lagila loke — the people grew doubtful; mane mane bhavi — thinking to themselves

10Longing to touch Him again, the goddess Ganga rises;
the people grew doubtful, thinking to themselves:

প্রতিদিন দেখি গঙ্গা যেমন তেমন ।
আজি অপরূপ তেজঃ শুনিয়ে গর্জন ॥ ১১ ॥

pratidina dekhi gaṅgā yemana temana |
āji aparūpa tejaḥ śuniẏe garjana || 11 ||

pratidina dekhi ganga — every day we see the Ganga; yemana temana — always the same; aji aparupa tejah — today a wondrous force; shuniye garjana — a roaring is heard

11"Every day we see the Ganga — she is always the same,
but today — a wondrous force, a roaring is heard.

মেঘ-বরিষণ নাহি বাঢ়য়ে সলিল ।
খরতর স্রোত বহে নীর উথলিল ॥ ১২ ॥

megha-bariṣaṇa nāhi bāṛhaẏe salila |
kharatara srota bahe nīra uthalila || 12 ||

megha-varishana nahi — there is no rain; badhaye salila — the water rises; kharatara srota bahe — the current runs swifter; nira uthalila — the waters surge

12There has been no rain, yet the water rises;
the current runs ever swifter, the waters surge."

এই মনে অনুমান করে সর্বজন ।
গঙ্গার ভকত এক আছয়ে ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ১৩ ॥

ei mane anumāna kare sarbajana |
gaṅgāra bhakata eka āchaẏe brāhmaṇa || 13 ||

ei mane — thus; anumana kare sarvajana — all the people conjecture; gangara bhakata eka — a devotee of the Ganga; achhaye brahmana — there was a brahmana

13So all the people conjectured.
[But there] was a brahmana devoted to the Ganga.

গঙ্গার প্রসাদে তার অন্তর নির্মল ।
ভূত ভবিষ্যৎ বিপ্র জানয়ে সকল ॥ ১৪ ॥

gaṅgāra prasāde tāra antara nirmala |
bhūta bhabiṣyat bipra jānaẏe sakala || 14 ||

gangara prasade — by the Ganga's grace; tara antara nirmala — his heart is pure; bhuta bhavishyat — past and future; vipra janaye sakala — the brahmana knows all

14By the Ganga's grace his heart was pure,
and that brahmana knew everything — past and future.

গঙ্গা আরাধনা করে জপে হরিনাম ।
গঙ্গা গৌরাঙ্গ যেন দেখে এক ঠাম ॥ ১৪+১ ॥

gaṅgā ārādhanā kare jape harināma |
gaṅgā gaurāṅga yena dekhe eka ṭhāma || 14+1 ||

ganga aradhana kare — worships the Ganga; jape harinama — chants the name of Hari; ganga gauranga — the Ganga and Gauranga; yena dekhe — that he may see; eka thama — in one place

14+1He worships the Ganga and chants the name of Hari,
[longing] to see the Ganga and Gauranga in one place.3

এই বাঞ্ছা সেই বিপ্র করিল হৃদয়ে ।
গঙ্গাতীরে কুটীর বান্ধিয়া সুখে রহে ॥ ১৪+২ ॥

ei bāñchā sei bipra karila hṛdaẏe |
gaṅgātīre kuṭīra bāndhiẏā sukhe rahe || 14+2 ||

ei vanchha — this desire; sei vipra — that brahmana; karila hridaye — held in his heart; gangatire — on the bank of the Ganga; kutira bandhiya — building a hut; sukhe rahe — lives happily

14+2With this desire in his heart that brahmana
built a hut on the bank of the Ganga and lived there happily.

গঙ্গা-মহোৎসব দেখি বাঢ়য়ে উল্লাস ।
চিন্তিতে চিন্তিতে তাহে ভেল পরকাশ ॥ ১৫ ॥

gaṅgā-mahotsaba dekhi bāṛhaẏe ullāsa |
cintite cintite tāhe bhela parakāśa || 15 ||

ganga-mahotsava dekhi — seeing the Ganga's festival; badhaye ullasa — joy increases; chintite chintite — pondering and pondering; tahe bhela parakasha — it was revealed to him

15Seeing the Ganga's festival, he grows ever more joyful;
he pondered and pondered — and it was revealed to him.

বিশ্বম্ভর মহাপ্রভু বয়স্যে বেষ্টিত ।
গঙ্গার সমীপে রহে দেখে আচম্বিত ॥ ১৬ ॥

biśbambhara mahāprabhu baẏasye beṣṭita |
gaṅgāra samīpe rahe dekhe ācambita || 16 ||

vishvambhara mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu Vishvambhara; vayasye veshtita — surrounded by friends; gangara samipe rahe — stands near the Ganga; dekhe achambita — [the brahmana] suddenly sees

16Suddenly he sees: Mahaprabhu Vishvambhara,
surrounded by His friends, standing by the Ganga.

গঙ্গা নিরিখয়ে প্রভু বড় অনুরাগে ।
দ্বিগুণ হইল দেহ অঙ্গের পুলকে ॥ ১৭ ॥

gaṅgā nirikhaẏe prabhu baṛa anurāge |
dbiguṇa haila deha aṅgera pulake || 17 ||

ganga nirikhaye prabhu — the Lord gazes at the Ganga; bada anurage — with great love; dviguna haila deha — the body grew twice its size; angera pulake — with the bristling of the hairs

17The Lord gazes at the Ganga with great love;
His body grew twice its size, so did the hairs on His body stand on end.

করুণা-অরুণ ছলছল করে আঁখি ।
দেখিয়া পাইল বিপ্র অন্তরের সাক্ষী ॥ ১৮ ॥

karuṇā-aruṇa chalachala kare āṁkhi |
dekhiẏā pāila bipra antarera sākṣī || 18 ||

karuna-aruna — reddened with tenderness; chhalachhala kare ankhi — the eyes brim with tears; dekhiya paila vipra — seeing it, the brahmana found; antarera sakshi — a witness for his heart

18His eyes, reddened with tenderness, brim with tears;
seeing this, the brahmana found a witness [to what had been revealed] to his heart.

এই সেই ভগবান্ কভু নহে আন ।
চিন্তিতে চিন্তিতে গেলা প্রভু-বিদ্যমান ॥ ১৯ ॥

ei sei bhagabān kabhu nahe āna |
cintite cintite gelā prabhu-bidyamāna || 19 ||

ei sei bhagavan — this is He, Bhagavan; kabhu nahe ana — none other; chintite chintite — so pondering; gela prabhu-vidyamana — went into the Lord's presence

19"This is He — Bhagavan, and none other!"
So pondering, he went up to the Lord.

প্রভুর নিকটে গিয়া দাণ্ডাইয়া দেখে ।
অবশ হঞাছে প্রভু গঙ্গা-অনুরাগে ॥ ২০ ॥

prabhura nikaṭe giẏā dāṇḍāiẏā dekhe |
abaśa hañāche prabhu gaṅgā-anurāge || 20 ||

prabhura nikate giya — going near the Lord; dandaiya dekhe — stands and sees; avasha hanachhe prabhu — the Lord is beside Himself; ganga-anurage — with the Ganga's love

20Coming close to the Lord, he stands and sees:
the Lord is beside Himself with the Ganga's love.

গঙ্গার হৃদয় প্রভু জানে মনে মনে ।
আগুসরি করে গঙ্গা কর-পরশনে ॥ ২১ ॥

gaṅgāra hṛdaẏa prabhu jāne mane mane |
āgusari kare gaṅgā kara-paraśane || 21 ||

gangara hridaya — the Ganga's heart; prabhu jane mane mane — the Lord knows within; agusari kare ganga — the Ganga comes forward; kara-parashane — touching His hands

21The Lord in His heart knows the Ganga's heart;
the Ganga comes forward and touches His hands.

কর-পরশনে গঙ্গার না পূরিল আশ ।
ঢেউ-ছলে করে গঙ্গা চরণ-সম্ভাষ ॥ ২২ ॥

kara-paraśane gaṅgāra nā pūrila āśa |
ḍheu-chale kare gaṅgā caraṇa-sambhāṣa || 22 ||

kara-parashane — by the touch of the hands; gangara na purila asha — the Ganga's desire was not fulfilled; dheu-chhale — under the guise of waves; kare ganga charana-sambhasha — the Ganga greets His feet

22But touching His hands did not fulfil the Ganga's desire:
under the guise of waves the Ganga clings to His feet.

মূর্তিমতী হৈয়া গঙ্গা প্রভু-কাছে রহে ।
করজোড় করিয়া চরণ-পদ্ম চাহে ॥ ২২+১ ॥

mūrtimatī haiẏā gaṅgā prabhu-kāche rahe |
karajoṛa kariẏā caraṇa-padma cāhe || 22+1 ||

murtimati haiya — taking a visible form; ganga — the Ganga; prabhu-kachhe rahe — stands near the Lord; karajoda kariya — with joined palms; charana-padma chahe — gazes at the lotus feet

22+1Taking a visible form, the Ganga stands near the Lord;4
with joined palms she gazes at His lotus feet.

দেখিয়া ব্রাহ্মণ পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ ।
দেখহ সকল লোক গঙ্গা গৌরাঙ্গ ॥ ২২+২ ॥

dekhiẏā brāhmaṇa pulakita saba aṅga |
dekhaha sakala loka gaṅgā gaurāṅga || 22+2 ||

dekhiya — seeing; brahmana — the brahmana; pulakita saba anga — thrilled in all his limbs; dekhaha — look; sakala loka — all people; ganga gauranga — the Ganga [and] Gauranga

22+2Seeing this, the brahmana thrilled all over:
"Look, all you people: the Ganga and Gauranga!"

প্রভু পরশিল গঙ্গা চরণ-কমলে ।
কৃতার্থ হইয়া গঙ্গা গেলা নিজ জলে ॥ ২২+৩ ॥

prabhu paraśila gaṅgā caraṇa-kamale |
kṛtārtha haiẏā gaṅgā gelā nija jale || 22+3 ||

prabhu — the Lord's; parashila ganga — the Ganga touched; charana-kamale — the lotus feet; kritartha haiya — her desire fulfilled; ganga gela — the Ganga went; nija jale — into her own waters

22+3The Ganga touched the Lord's lotus feet
and, her desire fulfilled, went back into her own waters.

গৌরাঙ্গ-নিকটে গঙ্গা কেহো না জানিল ।
ব্রাহ্মণ অভীষ্ট-ভরে নয়ানে দেখিল ॥ ২২+৪ ॥

gaurāṅga-nikaṭe gaṅgā keho nā jānila |
brāhmaṇa abhīṣṭa-bhare naẏāne dekhila || 22+4 ||

gauranga-nikate — near Gauranga; ganga — the Ganga; keho na janila — no one knew; brahmana — the brahmana; abhishta-bhare — in the fullness of his desire; nayane dekhila — saw with his eyes

22+4No one knew that the Ganga had been near Gauranga;
but the brahmana, attaining his desire, saw it with his own eyes.

সুরধুনী-অনুরাগ পাইয়া গৌরহরি ।
পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ কাঁপে থরথরি ॥ ২২+৫ ॥

suradhunī-anurāga pāiẏā gaurahari |
pulakita saba aṅga kāṁpe tharathari || 22+5 ||

suradhuni-anuraga — the love of the celestial river; paiya — receiving; gaurahari — Gaurahari; pulakita saba anga — thrilled in all His limbs; kape tharathari — trembles

22+5Receiving the love of the celestial river, Gaurahari
thrilled all over and trembled.

আবেশ হইয়া প্রভু বোলে হরিবোল ।
অবশ হইয়া নিজজনে দেই কোল ॥ ২৩ ॥

ābeśa haiẏā prabhu bole haribola |
abaśa haiẏā nijajane dei kola || 23 ||

avesha haiya prabhu — the Lord in ecstasy; bole haribola — cries "Haribol!"; avasha haiya — losing control; nijajane dei kola — embraces His own

23In ecstasy the Lord cries "Haribol!"
and, losing control of Himself, embraces His companions.

অরুণ-বরণ ভেল প্রেমার আরম্ভ ।
কদম্ব-কেশর জিনি পুলক-কদম্ব ॥ ২৪ ॥

aruṇa-baraṇa bhela premāra ārambha |
kadamba-keśara jini pulaka-kadamba || 24 ||

aruna-barana bhela — became crimson; premara arambha — the beginning of prema; kadamba-keshara jini — like kadamba filaments; pulaka-kadamba — a mass of bristling hairs

24He turned crimson — thus prema begins;
the hairs on His body stood up like the filaments of kadamba flowers.

প্রভু-অনুরাগে গঙ্গা হিয়ামাঝে রহে ।
শত শত ধারা আঁখি-সাগরেতে বহে ॥ ২৫ ॥

prabhu-anurāge gaṅgā hiẏāmājhe rahe |
śata śata dhārā āṁkhi-sāgarete bahe || 25 ||

prabhu-anurage — in love for the Lord; ganga hiya-majhe rahe — the Ganga abides in [His] heart; shata shata dhara — hundreds of streams; ankhi-sagarete bahe — flow from the ocean of His eyes

25In her love for the Lord the Ganga abides in His heart:
hundreds of streams flow from the ocean of His eyes.

লোমে লোমে বহে নীর লোকে বোলে ঘর্ম ।
উথলিল প্রেমসিন্ধু দ্রবময় ব্রহ্ম ॥ ২৬ ॥

lome lome bahe nīra loke bole gharma |
uthalila premasindhu drabamaẏa brahma || 26 ||

lome lome bahe nira — water flows from every pore; loke bole gharma — people say "sweat"; uthalila prema-sindhu — the ocean of prema surged; drava-maya brahma — Brahman in liquid form

26Moisture flows from every pore — people say, "It is sweat";
[but this] is the ocean of prema surging — Brahman in liquid form.

চৌদিকে সকল লোক হরি হরি বোলে ।
উথলিল প্রেমসিন্ধু আনন্দ-হিল্লোলে ॥ ২৭ ॥

caudike sakala loka hari hari bole |
uthalila premasindhu ānanda-hillole || 27 ||

chaudike sakala loka — on all sides all the people; hari hari bole — cry "Hari, Hari!"; uthalila prema-sindhu — the ocean of prema surged; ananda-hillole — in waves of bliss

27On all sides all the people cry "Hari, Hari!";
the ocean of prema surged in waves of bliss.

চমৎকৃত হৈল সব নদীয়া-সমাজ ।
গঙ্গার ভকত বিপ্র জানিলেক কাজ ॥ ২৮ ॥

camatkṛta haila saba nadīẏā-samāja |
gaṅgāra bhakata bipra jānileka kāja || 28 ||

chamatkrita haila — were astonished; saba nadiya-samaja — all the people of Nadia; gangara bhakata vipra — the brahmana devoted to the Ganga; janileka kaja — understood the matter

28All the people of Nadia were astonished;
the brahmana devoted to the Ganga understood the matter.

সেই ভগবান্ প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর দেব ।
ইহা দেখি বাঢ়ে গঙ্গা এই অনুভব ॥ ২৯ ॥

sei bhagabān prabhu biśbambhara deba |
ihā dekhi bāṛhe gaṅgā ei anubhaba || 29 ||

sei bhagavan — Bhagavan Himself; prabhu vishvambhara deva — Lord Vishvambharadeva; iha dekhi — seeing Him; badhe ganga — the Ganga rises; ei anubhava — so he realized

29"This Lord, Vishvambharadeva, is Bhagavan Himself:
seeing Him, the Ganga rises" — so he realized.

চরণে পড়িয়া বিপ্র করয়ে আর্তনাদ ।
এতদিনে গঙ্গা মোরে কৈল পরসাদ ॥ ৩০ ॥

caraṇe paṛiẏā bipra karaẏe ārtanāda |
etadine gaṅgā more kaila parasāda || 30 ||

charane padiya vipra — the brahmana, falling at His feet; karaye artanada — cries aloud; etadine — at last; ganga more kaila parasada — the Ganga has shown me grace

30Falling at His feet, the brahmana cries aloud:
"At last the Ganga has shown me her grace!

যোগীন্দ্র মুনীন্দ্র যাহা না পায় ধেয়ানে ।
হেন মহাপ্রভু আজি দেখিল নয়ানে ॥ ৩১ ॥

yogīndra munīndra yāhā nā pāẏa dheẏāne |
hena mahāprabhu āji dekhila naẏāne || 31 ||

yogindra munindra — the best of yogis and sages; yaha na paya dheyane — whom they do not attain in meditation; hena mahaprabhu — such a Mahaprabhu; aji dekhila nayane — today I saw with my eyes

31He whom the best of yogis and sages cannot attain in meditation —
such a Mahaprabhu I have seen today with my own eyes!"

ভূমে গড়াগড়ি যায় কান্দে আর্তনাদে ।
আপনা পাশরে বিপ্র প্রেমার আনন্দে ॥ ৩২ ॥

bhūme gaṛāgaṛi yāẏa kānde ārtanāde |
āpanā pāśare bipra premāra ānande || 32 ||

bhume gadagadi yaya — rolls on the ground; kande artanade — weeps crying out; apana pashare vipra — the brahmana forgot himself; premara anande — in the bliss of prema

32He rolls on the ground, weeping and crying out;
the brahmana forgot himself in the bliss of prema.

চতুর্দিগে সর্বজন দাণ্ডাইয়া রহে ।
বেকত-বদনে বিপ্র পূর্বকথা কহে ॥ ৩৩ ॥

caturdige sarbajana dāṇḍāiẏā rahe |
bekata-badane bipra pūrbakathā kahe || 33 ||

chaturdige sarvajana — all the people around; dandaiya rahe — stand; bekata-badane — openly; vipra purva-katha kahe — the brahmana tells the ancient story

33All the people stand around;
and the brahmana openly tells the ancient story.

অবশ ব্রাহ্মণ দেখি চলিলা ঠাকুর ।
নিজঘরে গেলা হিয়া আনন্দ প্রচুর ॥ ৩৪ ॥

abaśa brāhmaṇa dekhi calilā ṭhākura |
nijaghare gelā hiẏā ānanda pracura || 34 ||

avasha brahmana dekhi — seeing the brahmana beside himself; chalila thakura — Thakura left; nija-ghare gela — went to His home; hiya ananda prachura — His heart full of bliss

34Seeing the brahmana beside himself, Thakura5 went away
to His home, His heart full of bliss.

আদিকথা কহে বিপ্র শুনে সর্বজন ।
যেমনে হইল গঙ্গাদেবীর জনম ॥ ৩৫ ॥

ādikathā kahe bipra śune sarbajana |
yemane haila gaṅgādebīra janama || 35 ||

adi-katha kahe vipra — the brahmana tells the original story; shune sarvajana — all listen; yemane haila — how there came about; gangadevira janama — the birth of the goddess Ganga

35The brahmana tells the original story, and all listen —
how the goddess Ganga was born

এখনে বা গঙ্গাদেবী বাঢ়ে যে কারণে ।
সকল কহিয়ে সভে শুন সাবধানে ॥ ৩৬ ॥

ekhane bā gaṅgādebī bāṛhe ye kāraṇe |
sakala kahiẏe sabhe śuna sābadhāne || 36 ||

ekhane va — and now; gangadevi badhe — the goddess Ganga rises; ye karane — for what reason; sakala kahiye — I shall tell all; sabhe shuna savadhane — all listen attentively

36and for what reason the goddess Ganga rises now:
"I shall tell you all — listen attentively.

পূর্বে এককালে মহামহেশ ঠাকুর ।
কৃষ্ণগুণ গায় মহা আনন্দ প্রচুর ॥ ৩৭ ॥

pūrbe ekakāle mahāmaheśa ṭhākura |
kṛṣṇaguṇa gāẏa mahā ānanda pracura || 37 ||

purve ekakale — once long ago; maha-mahesha thakura — the great Mahesha Thakura; krishna-guna gaya — sang Krishna's virtues; maha ananda prachura — in great, abundant bliss

37Once the great Mahesha Thakura6
was singing of Krishna's virtues in great, abundant bliss.

নারদ ঠাকুর গায় গণেশ বাদক ।
পুলকে পূরিল অঙ্গ আপাদ-মস্তক ॥ ৩৮ ॥

nārada ṭhākura gāẏa gaṇeśa bādaka |
pulake pūrila aṅga āpāda-mastaka || 38 ||

narada thakura gaya — Narada Thakura sings; ganesha vadaka — Ganesha the drummer; pulake purila anga — their bodies filled with bristling hairs; apada-mastaka — from feet to head

38Narada Thakura sang, and Ganesha played the drum;
the hairs of their bodies stood on end from head to foot.

সঙ্গীত-সুতান তিনে গায় একমেলে ।
ব্রহ্মাণ্ড ভেদিল শব্দব্রহ্মের হিল্লোলে ॥ ৩৯ ॥

saṅgīta-sutāna tine gāẏa ekamele |
brahmāṇḍa bhedila śabdabrahmera hillole || 39 ||

sangita-sutana — a beautiful melody; tine gaya ekamele — the three sing together; brahmanda bhedila — pierced the universe; shabda-brahmera hillole — the waves of sound-Brahman

39All three sang a beautiful melody together;
the waves of sound-Brahman7 pierced the universe.

একে সে মহেশ আরে কৃষ্ণের আবেশ ।
নারদের বীণা তাহে বাদক গণেশ ॥ ৪০ ॥

eke se maheśa āre kṛṣṇera ābeśa |
nāradera bīṇā tāhe bādaka gaṇeśa || 40 ||

eke se mahesha — first, Mahesha himself; are krishnera avesha — and besides in ecstasy for Krishna; naradera vina — Narada's vina; tahe vadaka ganesha — and Ganesha as drummer

40First, it was Mahesha himself, and in the ecstasy of love for Krishna besides;
Narada had his vina, and Ganesha was on the drum as well!

অথির হইয়া প্রভু আইলা সেই ঠাঞি ।
মহেশ নারদ মিলি যথা গুণ গাই ॥ ৪১ ॥

athira haiẏā prabhu āilā sei ṭhāñi |
maheśa nārada mili yathā guṇa gāi || 41 ||

athira haiya prabhu — the Lord, unable to stay still; aila sei thani — came to that place; mahesha narada mili — Mahesha and Narada together; yatha guna gai — where they sang His virtues

41The Lord, unable to restrain Himself, came to the place
where Mahesha and Narada were singing His virtues together.

কহিল না গাও গুণ শুন হে মহেশ ।
তো সভার গান-তত্ত্ব না বুঝি বিশেষ ॥ ৪২ ॥

kahila nā gāo guṇa śuna he maheśa |
to sabhāra gāna-tattba nā bujhi biśeṣa || 42 ||

kahila — He said; na gao guna — do not sing the virtues; shuna he mahesha — listen, O Mahesha; to sabhara gana-tattva — the essence of your singing; na bujhi vishesha — I do not well understand

42He said: 'Do not sing My virtues, listen, Mahesha:
I do not well understand the essence of your singing.

তোমার সঙ্গীত-গানে নাহি রহে দেহ ।
আউলায় শরীর-বন্ধ দ্রবময় নেহ ॥ ৪৩ ॥

tomāra saṅgīta-gāne nāhi rahe deha |
āulāẏa śarīra-bandha drabamaẏa neha || 43 ||

tomara sangita-gane — at your singing; nahi rahe deha — I do not remain in the body; aulaya sharira-bandha — the bonds of the body loosen; drava-maya neha — it becomes liquid

43At your singing I cannot remain in My body:
the bonds of the body loosen, and it becomes liquid.'

শুনিঞা ঠাকুর-বাণী হাসয়ে মহেশ ।
গাইয়া দেখিব তত্ত্ব ইহার বিশেষ ॥ ৪৪ ॥

śuniñā ṭhākura-bāṇī hāsaẏe maheśa |
gāiẏā dekhiba tattba ihāra biśeṣa || 44 ||

shunina thakura-vani — hearing Thakura's words; hasaye mahesha — Mahesha smiles; gaiya dekhiba — I shall sing and see; tattva ihara vishesha — the essence of this

44Hearing Thakura's words, Mahesha smiles:
'I shall sing and see what the essence of this is.'

ইহা বলি গায় গুণ অধিক উল্লাস ।
ব্রহ্মাণ্ড ভরিল শব্দে এ ভূমি আকাশ ॥ ৪৫ ॥

ihā bali gāẏa guṇa adhika ullāsa |
brahmāṇḍa bharila śabde e bhūmi ākāśa || 45 ||

iha bali — so saying; gaya guna — sings the virtues; adhika ullasa — with greater delight; brahmanda bharila shabde — the sound filled the universe; e bhumi akasha — this earth and sky

45So saying, he sings His virtues with still greater delight;
the sound filled the universe — this earth and the sky.

দ্রবিলা শরীর প্রভু ক্ষীণ হৈল তনু ।
তরাসে মহেশ কৈল গান-সম্বরণ ॥ ৪৬ ॥

drabilā śarīra prabhu kṣīṇa haila tanu |
tarāse maheśa kaila gāna-sambaraṇa || 46 ||

drabila sharira prabhu — the Lord's body melted; kshina haila tanu — His form grew thin; tarase mahesha — in alarm Mahesha; kaila gana-samvarana — stopped his singing

46The Lord's body melted, His form grew thin;8
in alarm Mahesha stopped his singing.

সম্বরণ কৈল গান থির হৈল মতি ।
সেই সে কারুণ্য-জল লোকে আছে খ্যাতি ॥ ৪৭ ॥

sambaraṇa kaila gāna thira haila mati |
sei se kāruṇya-jala loke āche khyāti || 47 ||

samvarana kaila gana — when he stopped the singing; thira haila mati — the mind grew calm; sei se karunya-jala — that is the water of mercy; loke achhe khyati — famed in the world

47When he stopped singing, [the Lord's] mind grew calm;
this is that water of mercy famed in the world.

সেই দ্রবব্রহ্ম-নাম করুণার জল ।
তীর্থরূপী জনার্দন ঘোষয়ে সকল ॥ ৪৮ ॥

sei drababrahma-nāma karuṇāra jala |
tīrtharūpī janārdana ghoṣaẏe sakala || 48 ||

sei drava-brahma-nama — called Brahman in liquid form; karunara jala — the water of mercy; tirtha-rupi janardana — Janardana in the form of a holy place; ghoshaye sakala — all proclaim

48This water of mercy is called Brahman in liquid form;
all proclaim it to be Janardana in the form of a holy place.9

দুর্লভ দুর্লভ এই সংসার-ভিতর ।
কমণ্ডলু ভরি ব্রহ্মা রাখিল সে জল ॥ ৪৯ ॥

durlabha durlabha ei saṃsāra-bhitara |
kamaṇḍalu bhari brahmā rākhila se jala || 49 ||

durlabha durlabha — very, very rare; ei samsara-bhitara — in this world; kamandalu bhari — filling his kamandalu; brahma rakhila se jala — Brahma kept that water

49It is very, very rare in this world:
Brahma filled his kamandalu with it and kept it.

আছিলত বলিরাজ প্রভুর ভকত ।
তারে অনুগ্রহ লাগি ভৈ গেল বেকত ॥ ৫০ ॥

āchilata balirāja prabhura bhakata |
tāre anugraha lāgi bhai gela bekata || 50 ||

achhilata bali-raja — there was King Bali; prabhura bhakata — a devotee of the Lord; tare anugraha lagi — to show him grace; bhai gela bekata — [the Lord] appeared

50King Bali was a devotee of the Lord;
to show him grace, the Lord appeared [as Vamana].

ত্রিপাদ থুইতে প্রভু মাগিল পৃথিবী ।
ত্রিভুবন জোড়ে প্রভুর দ্বিপাদ-পদবী ॥ ৫১ ॥

tripāda thuite prabhu māgila pṛthibī |
tribhubana joṛe prabhura dbipāda-padabī || 51 ||

tripada thuite — to place three steps; prabhu magila prithivi — the Lord asked for land; tribhuvana jode — cover the three worlds; prabhura dvipada-padavi — the Lord's two steps

51The Lord asked for land on which to set three steps:
with two steps He covered the three worlds,

আর পাদ দিল বলির মাথার উপর ।
এছন কৃপালু প্রভু নাহি হয় আর ॥ ৫২ ॥

āra pāda dila balira māthāra upara |
echana kṛpālu prabhu nāhi haẏa āra || 52 ||

ara pada dila — the other foot He placed; balira mathara upara — on Bali's head; echhana kripalu prabhu — so merciful a Lord; nahi haya ara — there is no other

52and the third foot He placed on Bali's head.
There is no other Lord so merciful!

আর অপরূপ শুন ত্রিপাদ-মহিমা ।
ত্রিজগতে ধন্য হৈল যাহার করুণা ॥ ৫৩ ॥

āra aparūpa śuna tripāda-mahimā |
trijagate dhanya haila yāhāra karuṇā || 53 ||

ara aparupa shuna — hear another wonder; tripada-mahima — the glory of the third step; trijagate dhanya haila — the three worlds were blessed; yahara karuna — by whose mercy

53Hear also another wonder — the glory of the third step,
whose mercy blessed the three worlds:

ব্রহ্মাণ্ড ভেদিল সেই পদনখ-আগে ।
সেই পদে পাদ্য ব্রহ্মা দিল অনুরাগে ॥ ৫৪ ॥

brahmāṇḍa bhedila sei padanakha-āge |
sei pade pādya brahmā dila anurāge || 54 ||

brahmanda bhedila — the shell of the universe was pierced; sei pada-nakha-age — by the tip of that foot's nail; sei pade — to that foot; padya brahma dila — Brahma offered water for washing; anurage — lovingly

54with the tip of that foot's toenail the shell of the universe was pierced,
and to that foot Brahma lovingly offered water for washing.10

প্রভু-পাদাম্বুজ-জল পূজয়ে মস্তকে ।
ত্রিপাদ-সম্ভবা গঙ্গা তেঞি বোলে লোকে ॥ ৫৫ ॥

prabhu-pādāmbuja-jala pūjaẏe mastake |
tripāda-sambhabā gaṅgā teñi bole loke || 55 ||

prabhu-padambuja-jala — the water from the Lord's lotus feet; pujaye mastake — they honour on their heads; tripada-sambhava ganga — the Ganga born of the third step; teni bole loke — therefore people say

55The water from the Lord's lotus feet [people] reverently place on their heads;
that is why the Ganga is called 'born of the third step'.

হেনই ঠাকুর মহাপ্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
দেখহ সকল লোক নয়ান-গোচর ॥ ৫৬ ॥

henai ṭhākura mahāprabhu biśbambhara |
dekhaha sakala loka naẏāna-gocara || 56 ||

henai thakura — such is Thakura; mahaprabhu vishvambhara — Mahaprabhu Vishvambhara; dekhaha sakala loka — behold, all people; nayana-gochara — before your eyes

56Such is Thakura — Mahaprabhu Vishvambhara:
behold, all of you, here He is before your eyes!

দেখি গঙ্গাদেবী পূর্ব-সোঙরণ হৈল ।
প্রেম-অনুরাগে গঙ্গা বাঢ়িতে লাগিল ॥ ৫৭ ॥

dekhi gaṅgādebī pūrba-soṅaraṇa haila |
prema-anurāge gaṅgā bāṛhite lāgila || 57 ||

dekhi gangadevi — seeing, the goddess Ganga; purva-songarana haila — remembered the past; prema-anurage — in love and tenderness; ganga badhite lagila — the Ganga began to rise

57Seeing Him, the goddess Ganga remembered the past
and in love and tenderness began to rise.

গঙ্গাপানে চাহে প্রভু অনুরাগ-দিঠে ।
অমৃত-অধিক গোরা-অঙ্গ লাগে মিঠে ॥ ৫৮ ॥

gaṅgāpāne cāhe prabhu anurāga-diṭhe |
amṛta-adhika gorā-aṅga lāge miṭhe || 58 ||

ganga-pane chahe prabhu — the Lord looks at the Ganga; anuraga-dithe — with a loving gaze; amrita-adhika — more than nectar; gora-anga lage mithe — Gora's body tastes sweet

58The Lord looks at the Ganga with a loving gaze,
and Gora's body is sweeter to her than nectar.

চরণ-পরশে পুনঃ তরঙ্গের ছলে ।
অনুভবে জানি মো কহিল সভারে ॥ ৫৯ ॥

caraṇa-paraśe punaḥ taraṅgera chale |
anubhabe jāni mo kahila sabhāre || 59 ||

charana-parashe punah — again touches the feet; tarangera chhale — under the guise of waves; anubhave jani — knowing by realization; mo kahila sabhare — I have told all

59Under the guise of waves she touches His feet again;
I have realized this by inner experience and told you all."

শুনিঞা সকল লোকের বাঢ়ল উল্লাস ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৬০ ॥

śuniñā sakala lokera bāṛhala ullāsa |
gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e locanadāsa || 60 ||

shunina — hearing; sakala lokera badhala ullasa — all the people's joy increased; gora-guna gaya sukhe — joyfully sings Gora's virtues; e lochana-dasa — this Lochana Dasa

60Hearing this, all the people rejoiced;
joyfully Lochana Dasa sings of Gora's virtues.

Raga dhanashi; disha: "Are, the sweetness of my Gora's lotus feet! The bees, His devotees, fly up, circle and fall [upon them]. Are are haya!" (murchha). "Listen to this wondrous tale, the song of Gora's virtues — a name auspicious to the ear!"

এইমতে কতদিন গোঙাইলা সুখে ।
বান্ধব-সহিতে প্রভু আনন্দ-কৌতুকে ॥ ৬১ ॥

eimate katadina goṅāilā sukhe |
bāndhaba-sahite prabhu ānanda-kautuke || 61 ||

eimate — thus; kata dina gongaila sukhe — spent some days happily; bandhava-sahite prabhu — the Lord with His friends; ananda-kautuke — in joy and play

61Thus [the Lord] spent some days in happiness,
in joy and play together with His friends.

একদিন মনে মনে কৈল আচম্বিত ।
পূর্বদেশে যাব আমি সর্বলোক-হিত ॥ ৬২ ॥

ekadina mane mane kaila ācambita |
pūrbadeśe yāba āmi sarbaloka-hita || 62 ||

ekadina — one day; mane mane kaila achambita — suddenly resolved within; purva-deshe yaba ami — I shall go to the eastern land; sarvaloka-hita — for the good of all people

62One day He suddenly resolved within Himself:
"I shall go to the eastern country — for the good of all people.

পাণ্ডব-বর্জিত দেশ সর্বলোকে গায় ।
গঙ্গা হৈয়া গঙ্গা নহে এই সাক্ষী তায় ॥ ৬৩ ॥

pāṇḍaba-barjita deśa sarbaloke gāẏa |
gaṅgā haiẏā gaṅgā nahe ei sākṣī tāẏa || 63 ||

pandava-varjita desha — the land the Pandavas avoided; sarvaloke gaya — everyone says; ganga haiya ganga nahe — being the Ganga, not the Ganga; ei sakshi taya — this is the proof of it

63Everyone says it is the land the Pandavas avoided;11
[the Padma there] is the Ganga and yet not the Ganga: this is the proof of it.

আমার পরশে পদ্মাবতী হৈব ধন্য ।
সর্বলোক আমা বহি না জানিব অন্য ॥ ৬৪ ॥

āmāra paraśe padmābatī haiba dhanya |
sarbaloka āmā bahi nā jāniba anya || 64 ||

amara parashe — by My touch; padmavati haiba dhanya — the Padmavati will be blessed; sarvaloka — all people; ama bahi na janiba anya — will know none but Me

64By My touch the Padmavati will become blessed;
all the people will know no one but Me."

হেন যুকতি প্রভু করি অনুমানে ।
মায়েরে কহিল যাব ধন উপার্জনে ॥ ৬৫ ॥

hena yukati prabhu kari anumāne |
māẏere kahila yāba dhana upārjane || 65 ||

hena yukati — such a plan; prabhu kari anumane — the Lord, considering; mayere kahila — told His mother; yaba dhana uparjane — I shall go to earn money

65Having thus reasoned within Himself,
the Lord told His mother: "I shall go to earn money."

যাত্রা করি যায় প্রভু সঙ্গে নিজজন ।
ছটফট করে শচী-মায়ের পরাণ ॥ ৬৬ ॥

yātrā kari yāẏa prabhu saṅge nijajana |
chaṭaphaṭa kare śacī-māẏera parāṇa || 66 ||

yatra kari yaya prabhu — the Lord sets out on the journey; sange nijajana — with His own; chhataphata kare — is tossed about; shachi-mayera parana — Mother Shachi's heart

66The Lord sets out on the journey together with His own;
Mother Shachi's heart is tossed with anxiety.

কাতর হৃদয়ে শচী কহয়ে পুত্রেরে ।
শুন নিবেদন বাপু কহিয়ে তোমারে ॥ ৬৭ ॥

kātara hṛdaẏe śacī kahaẏe putrere |
śuna nibedana bāpu kahiẏe tomāre || 67 ||

katara hridaye — with an aching heart; shachi kahaye putrere — Shachi says to her son; shuna nivedana bapu — hear my plea, child; kahiye tomare — I tell You

67With an aching heart Shachi says to her son:
"Listen, my child, to what I tell You.

ধন উপার্জনে দূরদেশে যাবে তুমি ।
তোমা না দেখিলে কেমনে জীব আমি ॥ ৬৮ ॥

dhana upārjane dūradeśe yābe tumi |
tomā nā dekhile kemane jība āmi || 68 ||

dhana uparjane — to earn money; dura-deshe yabe tumi — You will go to a distant land; toma na dekhile — not seeing You; kemane jiba ami — how shall I live

68You are going to a distant land to earn money —
how shall I live without seeing You?

জল বিনু যেন মীন না ধরে পরাণ ।
তোমা বিনু আমার তেমন সমাধান ॥ ৬৯ ॥

jala binu yena mīna nā dhare parāṇa |
tomā binu āmāra temana samādhāna || 69 ||

jala vinu — without water; yena mina — as a fish; na dhare parana — cannot keep its life; toma vinu amara — without You for me; temana samadhana — so it will be

69As a fish without water cannot live,
so it is with me without You.

তোমার মুখচন্দ্র মনেতে ভাবিয়া ।
মরি যাব বাপ হের তোমা না দেখিয়া ॥ ৭০ ॥

tomāra mukhacandra manete bhābiẏā |
mari yāba bāpa hera tomā nā dekhiẏā || 70 ||

tomara mukha-chandra — Your moonlike face; manete bhaviya — thinking of; mari yaba bapa hera — I shall die, my child; toma na dekhiya — not seeing You

70Thinking of Your moonlike face,
I shall die, my child, not seeing You."

মায়ের বচন শুনি প্রভু দামোদর ।
বিনয় করিয়া কৈল প্রবোধ-উত্তর ॥ ৭১ ॥

māẏera bacana śuni prabhu dāmodara |
binaẏa kariẏā kaila prabodha-uttara || 71 ||

mayera bachana shuni — hearing His mother's words; prabhu damodara — Lord Damodara; vinaya kariya — humbly; kaila prabodha-uttara — gave a consoling answer

71Hearing His mother's words, Lord Damodara12
humbly answered her, consoling her:

আমার বিচ্ছেদে ডর না ভাবিহ তুমি ।
নিকটে তোমার ঠাঞি আসিব যে আমি ॥ ৭২ ॥

āmāra bicchede ḍara nā bhābiha tumi |
nikaṭe tomāra ṭhāñi āsiba ye āmi || 72 ||

amara vichchhede — of separation from Me; dara na bhaviha tumi — do not fear; nikate — soon; tomara thani asiba ye ami — I shall come back to you

72"Do not fear separation from Me:
I shall soon come back to you."

লক্ষ্মীরে কহিল প্রভু হাসিয়া উত্তর ।
মাতার সেবায় তুমি হইবে তৎপর ॥ ৭৩ ॥

lakṣmīre kahila prabhu hāsiẏā uttara |
mātāra sebāẏa tumi haibe tatpara || 73 ||

lakshmire kahila prabhu — to Lakshmi the Lord said; hasiya uttara — smiling in reply; matara sevaya — in serving My mother; tumi haibe tatpara — be diligent

73To Lakshmi the Lord said with a smile:
"Be diligent in serving My mother."

মায়ে যত কৈল কিছু না শুনিল পহুঁ ।
শুভযাত্রা করি যায় হাসি লহু লহু ॥ ৭৪ ॥

māẏe yata kaila kichu nā śunila pahuṁ |
śubhayātrā kari yāẏa hāsi lahu lahu || 74 ||

maye yata kaila — whatever His mother said; kichhu na shunila pahun — the Lord heeded nothing; shubha-yatra kari — setting out auspiciously; yaya hasi lahu lahu — goes softly smiling

74Whatever His mother said, the Lord paid no heed:
setting out on the auspicious journey, He goes, softly smiling.

চলিল সে মহাপ্রভু সঙ্গে নিজজন ।
কৌতুকে ভ্রময়ে প্রভু আনন্দিত মন ॥ ৭৫ ॥

calila se mahāprabhu saṅge nijajana |
kautuke bhramaẏe prabhu ānandita mana || 75 ||

chalila se mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu set out; sange nijajana — with His own; kautuke bhramaye prabhu — the Lord travels merrily; anandita mana — with a joyful heart

75Mahaprabhu set out with His companions
and travels about, merry, with a joyful heart.

যেখানে সেখানে যায় প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
দেখি সেখানের লোক হয়ে ত ফাঁফর ॥ ৭৬ ॥

yekhāne sekhāne yāẏa prabhu biśbambhara |
dekhi sekhānera loka haẏe ta phāṁphara || 76 ||

yekhane sekhane yaya — wherever goes; prabhu vishvambhara — Lord Vishvambhara; dekhi sekhanera loka — the people there, seeing [Him]; haye ta phaphara — are bewildered

76Wherever Lord Vishvambhara went,
the people there, seeing Him, lost their heads.

সে রূপ দেখিতে কারো না লেউটে আঁখি ।
কেহ বোলে এই রূপ অহর্নিশি দেখি ॥ ৭৭ ॥

se rūpa dekhite kāro nā leuṭe āṁkhi |
keha bole ei rūpa aharniśi dekhi || 77 ||

se rupa dekhite — seeing that beauty; karo na leute ankhi — no one's eyes turn away; keha bole — some say; ei rupa aharnishi dekhi — may we see this beauty day and night

77Seeing His beauty, no one can take their eyes away;
some say: "If only we could see this beauty day and night!"

পুরনারীগণ বোলে দেখিয়া বদন ।
সফল জনম আজি সফল নয়ন ॥ ৭৮ ॥

puranārīgaṇa bole dekhiẏā badana |
saphala janama āji saphala naẏana || 78 ||

puranarigana bole — the townswomen say; dekhiya badana — seeing His face; saphala janama aji — today our birth is fruitful; saphala nayana — our eyes are fruitful

78The women, seeing His face, say:
"Today our birth is fruitful, our eyes are fruitful!

কোন্ ভাগ্যবতী মায়ে ধরিল উদরে ।
কভু নাহি দেখি হেন সুন্দর শরীরে ॥ ৭৯ ॥

kon bhāgyabatī māẏe dharila udare |
kabhu nāhi dekhi hena sundara śarīre || 79 ||

kon bhagyavati maye — what fortunate mother; dharila udare — bore in her womb; kabhu nahi dekhi — never have we seen; hena sundara sharire — so beautiful a body

79What fortunate mother bore Him in her womb?
Never have we seen so beautiful a body!

হরগৌরী আরাধিল কোন্ ভাগ্যবতী ।
হেন রূপে হেন গুণে মিলিয়াছে পতি ॥ ৮০ ॥

haragaurī ārādhila kon bhāgyabatī |
hena rūpe hena guṇe miliẏāche pati || 80 ||

hara-gauri aradhila — worshipped Hara and Gauri; kon bhagyavati — what fortunate woman; hena rupe hena gune — of such beauty, such virtues; miliyachhe pati — has gained a husband

80What fortunate woman, having worshipped Hara and Gauri,
has gained a husband of such beauty, such virtues?

নবীন-কাঞ্চন জিনি অঙ্গের কিরণ ।
সুমেরু-পর্বত জিনি দেহের গঠন ॥ ৮১ ॥

nabīna-kāñcana jini aṅgera kiraṇa |
sumeru-parbata jini dehera gaṭhana || 81 ||

navina-kanchana jini — surpassing new gold; angera kirana — the radiance of the body; sumeru-parvata jini — surpassing Mount Sumeru; dehera gathana — the build of the body

81The radiance of His body surpasses new gold,
the build of His body Mount Sumeru.

সহজ-রূপের নাহি ভুবনে তুলনা ।
যজ্ঞসূত্র অতিশয় তাহাতে শোভনা ॥ ৮২ ॥

sahaja-rūpera nāhi bhubane tulanā |
yajñasūtra atiśaẏa tāhāte śobhanā || 82 ||

sahaja-rupera — of the natural beauty; nahi bhuvane tulana — no equal in the world; yajna-sutra — the sacred thread; atishaya tahate shobhana — is exceedingly lovely on it

82His natural beauty has no equal in the world,
and the sacred thread makes it lovelier still.

মরি যাই হেরিয়া সুন্দর মুখের হাসি ।
প্রেমবতী-হৃদয়ে রহল তেঞো পশি ॥ ৮৩ ॥

mari yāi heriẏā sundara mukhera hāsi |
premabatī-hṛdaẏe rahala teño paśi || 83 ||

mari yai heriya — one could die seeing; sundara mukhera hasi — the smile on the beautiful face; premavati-hridaye — in the hearts of loving women; rahala teno pashi — He entered and remained

83One could die seeing the smile on His beautiful face!"
He entered and remained in the hearts of the loving women.

কোন্ ভাগ্যবতী কৃষ্ণের রসতত্ত্ব-জ্ঞাতা ।
অনুমানি কহে সেই নির্যাস-বারতা ॥ ৮৪ ॥

kon bhāgyabatī kṛṣṇera rasatattba-jñātā |
anumāni kahe sei niryāsa-bāratā || 84 ||

kon bhagyavati — a fortunate woman; krishnera rasa-tattva-jnata — knowing the truth of Krishna's rasa; anumani kahe — guessing, speaks; sei niryasa-barata — the very essence

84One fortunate woman who knew the truth of Krishna's rasa,
guessing, spoke the very essence:13

দীঘল সুন্দর আঁখি পুণ্ডরীক জিনি ।
অপরূপ তাহে চারু সুতরল চাহনি ॥ ৮৫ ॥

dīghala sundara āṁkhi puṇḍarīka jini |
aparūpa tāhe cāru sutarala cāhani || 85 ||

dighala sundara ankhi — long beautiful eyes; pundarika jini — surpassing lotuses; aparupa tahe — and in them a wondrous; charu sutarala chahani — lovely tremulous glance

85"Long, beautiful eyes surpassing lotuses,
and in them a wondrous, lovely, tremulous glance.

দেখি যেন রাধার বল্লভ হেন ঠাম ।
রাধার বরণ অঙ্গ দেখি বিদ্যমান ॥ ৮৬ ॥

dekhi yena rādhāra ballabha hena ṭhāma |
rādhāra baraṇa aṅga dekhi bidyamāna || 86 ||

dekhi yena — it seems to me; radhara vallabha — Radha's Beloved; hena thama — in such a form; radhara barana anga — a body of Radha's complexion; dekhi vidyamana — I see before me

86It seems to me this is Radha's Beloved in such a form —
I see before me a body of Radha's complexion."14

সকল যুবতী মেলি কহিতে লাগিলা ।
শুনি বিশ্বম্ভর প্রভু উলটি চলিলা ॥ ৮৬+১ ॥

sakala yubatī meli kahite lāgilā |
śuni biśbambhara prabhu ulaṭi calilā || 86+1 ||

sakala yuvati meli — all the young women together; kahite lagila — began to speak; shuni — hearing; vishvambhara prabhu — Lord Vishvambhara; ulati chalila — turned back

86+1Thus all the young women spoke together;
hearing them, Lord Vishvambhara turned back.15

সরস নয়ানে প্রভু চাহিলা সবারে ।
প্রেমে গরগর তারা আপনা পাসরে ॥ ৮৬+২ ॥

sarasa naẏāne prabhu cāhilā sabāre |
preme garagara tārā āpanā pāsare || 86+2 ||

sarasa nayane — with eyes full of rasa; prabhu chahila sabare — the Lord looked at all; preme garagara — overwhelmed with prema; tara apana pasare — they forget themselves

86+2With eyes full of rasa the Lord looked at them all,
and they, overwhelmed with prema, forgot themselves.

পদ্মাবতী-স্নান কৈল যে আছিল বিধি ।
চরণ-পরশে গঙ্গাসম ভেল নদী ॥ ৮৭ ॥

padmābatī-snāna kaila ye āchila bidhi |
caraṇa-paraśe gaṅgāsama bhela nadī || 87 ||

padmavati-snana kaila — bathed in the Padmavati; ye achhila vidhi — as prescribed; charana-parashe — by the touch of His feet; ganga-sama bhela nadi — the river became like the Ganga

87[The Lord] bathed in the Padmavati as prescribed:
by the touch of His feet the river became like the Ganga.

পদ্মাবতী মহাবেগা পুলিন-সংযুতা ।
কুম্ভীর-কচ্ছপ-মীনে অতি সুশোভিতা ॥ ৮৮ ॥

padmābatī mahābegā pulina-saṃyutā |
kumbhīra-kacchapa-mīne ati suśobhitā || 88 ||

padmavati mahavega — the swift Padmavati; pulina-samyuta — with sandbanks; kumbhira-kachchhapa-mine — with crocodiles, tortoises, fish; ati sushobhita — very beautiful

88The swift Padmavati with her sandbanks
is beautiful with crocodiles, tortoises and fish.

ব্রাহ্মণ-সজ্জন সব বৈসে তার তটে ।
দিব্য পুরুষ-নারী স্নান করে ঘাটে ॥ ৮৯ ॥

brāhmaṇa-sajjana saba baise tāra taṭe |
dibya puruṣa-nārī snāna kare ghāṭe || 89 ||

brahmana-sajjana saba — all brahmanas and good people; baise tara tate — live on her banks; divya purusha-nari — noble men and women; snana kare ghate — bathe at the ghats

89On her banks live brahmanas and good people;
noble men and women bathe at her ghats.

বিশ্বম্ভর-স্নানে পূতা ভেল পদ্মাবতী ।
সর্বলোক-পাপ হরে স্নান করি তথি ॥ ৯০ ॥

biśbambhara-snāne pūtā bhela padmābatī |
sarbaloka-pāpa hare snāna kari tathi || 90 ||

vishvambhara-snane — by Vishvambhara's bath; puta bhela padmavati — the Padmavati was purified; sarvaloka-papa hare — takes away the sins of all; snana kari tathi — who bathe in her

90By Vishvambhara's bath the Padmavati was purified:
she takes away the sins of all who bathe in her.

প্রেমভক্তি হয় কৃষ্ণ-চরণারবিন্দে ।
স্নান করে কভু যদি বৈষ্ণব না নিন্দে ॥ ৯১ ॥

premabhakti haẏa kṛṣṇa-caraṇārabinde |
snāna kare kabhu yadi baiṣṇaba nā ninde || 91 ||

prema-bhakti haya — prema-bhakti arises; krishna-charanaravinde — for Krishna's lotus feet; snana kare — [in one who] bathes; kabhu yadi vaishnava na ninde — if only he never blasphemes the Vaishnavas

91Prema-bhakti for Krishna's lotus feet arises
in whoever bathes in her, if only he does not blaspheme the Vaishnavas.

সেই পদ্মাবতী-তটবাসী যত জন ।
গৌরচন্দ্র দেখি শ্লাঘ্য করিল নয়ন ॥ ৯২ ॥

sei padmābatī-taṭabāsī yata jana |
gauracandra dekhi ślāghya karila naẏana || 92 ||

sei padmavati-tata-basi — dwelling on the banks of the Padmavati; yata jana — all the people; gaurachandra dekhi — seeing Gaurachandra; shlaghya karila nayana — made their eyes blessed

92All who lived on the banks of the Padmavati,
seeing Gaurachandra, made their eyes blessed.

সেই পদ্মাবতী-তীরে ভ্রমে গৌরহরি ।
সে দেশ ভকত হৈল শ্রীচরণ ধরি ॥ ৯৩ ॥

sei padmābatī-tīre bhrame gaurahari |
se deśa bhakata haila śrīcaraṇa dhari || 93 ||

sei padmavati-tire — on the banks of the Padmavati; bhrame gaurahari — Gaurahari wanders; se desha bhakata haila — that land became devoted; shri-charana dhari — clasping His feet

93Gaurahari wanders along the banks of the Padmavati;
that land, clasping His feet, became devoted.

শীতল চরণ পাঞা ধরণী শীতল ।
পুলকিত হৈলা দেবী গেল অমঙ্গল ॥ ৯৪ ॥

śītala caraṇa pāñā dharaṇī śītala |
pulakita hailā debī gela amaṅgala || 94 ||

shitala charana pana — receiving the cool feet; dharani shitala — the earth became cool; pulakita haila devi — the goddess thrilled; gela amangala — the inauspicious departed

94Receiving His cool feet, the earth became cool;
the goddess thrilled with joy — all that was inauspicious departed.

সে দেশ তারিল আগে বহু যত্ন করি ।
পাণ্ডব-বর্জিত দেশ দূর কৈল হরি ॥ ৯৫ ॥

se deśa tārila āge bahu yatna kari |
pāṇḍaba-barjita deśa dūra kaila hari || 95 ||

se desha tarila age — first He delivered that land; bahu yatna kari — with great care; pandava-varjita desha — [the name] "land the Pandavas avoided"; dura kaila hari — Hari removed

95Hari first of all delivered that land with great care:
He removed [the stigma] of the land the Pandavas avoided.

চণ্ডাল পতিত কিবা সজ্জন দুর্জন ।
সভারে যাচিয়া প্রভু দিল হরিনাম ॥ ৯৬ ॥

caṇḍāla patita kibā sajjana durjana |
sabhāre yāciẏā prabhu dila harināma || 96 ||

chandala patita — chandalas, the fallen; kiva sajjana durjana — good or wicked; sabhare yachiya — entreating all; prabhu dila hari-nama — the Lord gave the name of Hari

96Chandalas and the fallen, the good and the wicked —
the Lord, Himself entreating them, gave all the name of Hari.

শুচি বা অশুচি কিবা আচার বিচার ।
না মানিল সভারে করিল ভবপার ॥ ৯৭ ॥

śuci bā aśuci kibā ācāra bicāra |
nā mānila sabhāre karila bhabapāra || 97 ||

shuchi va ashuchi — clean or unclean; kiva achara vichara — what customs, what rules; na manila — He did not regard; sabhare karila bhava-para — carried all across the ocean of existence

97Clean or unclean, what customs, what rules —
He did not regard them and carried all across the ocean of existence.

নাম-সংকীর্তন প্রভু নৌকা সাজাইয়া ।
পার কৈল সব জীবে আপনি যাচিয়া ॥ ৯৮ ॥

nāma-saṃkīrtana prabhu naukā sājāiẏā |
pāra kaila saba jībe āpani yāciẏā || 98 ||

nama-sankirtana — of the sankirtana of the name; prabhu nauka sajaiya — the Lord, fitting out the boat; para kaila saba jive — carried all souls across; apani yachiya — Himself entreating

98Fitting out the boat of the sankirtana of the name,
the Lord, Himself entreating, carried all souls across.

যে জন পলায় তারে ধরি কোলে করি ।
কাণ্ডারীর রূপে পার করে গৌরহরি ॥ ৯৯ ॥

ye jana palāẏa tāre dhari kole kari |
kāṇḍārīra rūpe pāra kare gaurahari || 99 ||

ye jana palaya — whoever runs away; tare dhari kole kari — catching and embracing him; kandarira rupe — as the helmsman; para kare gaurahari — Gaurahari carries across

99And whoever runs away — Gaurahari catches and embraces him
and, as the helmsman, carries him to the other shore.

এহেন করুণা নাহি শুনি কোন যুগে ।
কোন্ অবতারে কোথা কে বা পাপ মাগে ॥ ১০০ ॥

ehena karuṇā nāhi śuni kona yuge |
kon abatāre kothā ke bā pāpa māge || 100 ||

ehena karuna — such mercy; nahi shuni kona yuge — is not heard of in any age; kon avatare kotha — in what avatara, where; ke va papa mage — who begged for sins

100Never, in any age, has such mercy been heard of:
in what avatara, where, did anyone beg for sins?16

সভারে পবিত্র কৈল সম-ভাব করি ।
রাধাকৃষ্ণ-প্রেমের করিল অধিকারী ॥ ১০১ ॥

sabhāre pabitra kaila sama-bhāba kari |
rādhākṛṣṇa-premera karila adhikārī || 101 ||

sabhare pavitra kaila — purified all; sama-bhava kari — being equally disposed; radha-krishna-premera — of prema for Radha and Krishna; karila adhikari — made them fit

101He purified all, equally disposed towards all,
and made them fit for prema for Radha and Krishna.

বিদ্যাদান কৈল প্রভু অশেষ-বিশেষে ।
পণ্ডিত হইল সভে দিন পক্ষ মাসে ॥ ১০২ ॥

bidyādāna kaila prabhu aśeṣa-biśeṣe |
paṇḍita haila sabhe dina pakṣa māse || 102 ||

vidya-dana kaila prabhu — the Lord gave knowledge; ashesha-visheshe — endlessly and generously; pandita haila sabhe — all became pandits; dina paksha mase — in days, fortnights, months

102The Lord gave knowledge generously, without end:
all became pandits in days, fortnights, months.

দয়ার সাগর প্রভু সর্বলোকপতি ।
করুণা প্রকাশি লোকে শুদ্ধ কৈল মতি ॥ ১০৩ ॥

daẏāra sāgara prabhu sarbalokapati |
karuṇā prakāśi loke śuddha kaila mati || 103 ||

dayara sagara prabhu — the Lord, ocean of mercy; sarvaloka-pati — master of all worlds; karuna prakashi — revealing mercy; loke shuddha kaila mati — purified people's minds

103The Lord, the ocean of mercy, master of all the worlds,
revealing His mercy, purified people's minds.

এইমতে আছে প্রভু সজ্জন-সমাজে ।
এথা লক্ষ্মী শচীদেবী নবদ্বীপে আছে ॥ ১০৪ ॥

eimate āche prabhu sajjana-samāje |
ethā lakṣmī śacīdebī nabadbīpe āche || 104 ||

eimate achhe prabhu — thus the Lord stays; sajjana-samaje — in the company of good people; etha — here; lakshmi shachidevi — Lakshmi and Shachi-devi; navadvipe achhe — are in Navadvipa

104Thus the Lord stays in the company of good people,
while here in Navadvipa are Lakshmi and Shachi-devi.

পতিব্রতা লক্ষ্মীদেবী পতিগত-প্রাণ ।
আনন্দে শচীর সেবা করয়ে বিধান ॥ ১০৫ ॥

patibratā lakṣmīdebī patigata-prāṇa |
ānande śacīra sebā karaẏe bidhāna || 105 ||

pativrata lakshmidevi — faithful Lakshmi-devi; patigata-prana — whose life is her husband; anande — joyfully; shachira seva karaye vidhana — serves Shachi as is proper

105Faithful Lakshmi-devi, for whom her husband is her very life,
serves Shachi joyfully, as is proper.

দেবতার সজ্জ করে গৃহ-সম্মার্জন ।
ধূপ দীপ নৈবেদ্য গন্ধ মাল্য চন্দন ॥ ১০৬ ॥

debatāra sajja kare gṛha-sammārjana |
dhūpa dīpa naibedya gandha mālya candana || 106 ||

devatara sajja kare — prepares [the room] of the Deities; griha-sammarjana — sweeps and cleans the house; dhupa dipa naivedya — incense, lamps, offerings; gandha malya chandana — scents, garlands, sandal

106She tidies the Deities' room, sweeps and cleans the house,
[prepares] incense, lamps, offerings, scents, garlands and sandal.

সকল সংস্করি দেই দেবতার ঘরে ।
বধূর শীলতায় শচী আপনা পাশরে ॥ ১০৭ ॥

sakala saṃskari dei debatāra ghare |
badhūra śīlatāẏa śacī āpanā pāśare || 107 ||

sakala samskari — preparing everything; dei devatara ghare — places it in the Deities' room; badhura shilataya — by the daughter-in-law's good nature; shachi apana pashare — Shachi forgets herself

107Having prepared everything, she takes it to the Deities' room;
her daughter-in-law's good nature makes Shachi forget herself.

বশ ভেল শচীদেবী বধূর চরিতে ।
পুলকিত বধূ শচীমাতার পিরীতে ॥ ১০৮ ॥

baśa bhela śacīdebī badhūra carite |
pulakita badhū śacīmātāra pirīte || 108 ||

basha bhela shachidevi — Shachi-devi was won over; badhura charite — by her daughter-in-law's conduct; pulakita badhu — the daughter-in-law thrills; shachi-matara pirite — at Mother Shachi's love

108Shachi-devi is won over by her daughter-in-law's conduct,
and the daughter-in-law thrills with joy at Mother Shachi's love.

✦

Notes

  1. The end of the summary (on the journey to East Bengal and Lakshmi's departure) is almost illegible in the scan of the edition; it is translated from the surviving words, and gaps are marked […].
  2. The name of the raga is illegible in the scan of A; raga shri follows the 1903 edition (the 1983 edition has pathamanjari). In the 1983 edition this section is the "Fifth Chapter".
  3. Vv. 14+1 – 14+2 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition does not have them.
  4. Vv. 22+1 – 22+5 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition gives vv. 22+1 – 22+2 in a footnote as the additional reading of one manuscript, and does not have vv. 22+3 – 22+5.
  5. Thakura ("master") — here the Lord Himself.
  6. Mahesha — Shiva; Lochana Dasa respectfully calls him, like Narada, "Thakura".
  7. Shabda-brahman — Brahman as sound, transcendental sound.
  8. This is the Puranic story of how Vishnu melted on hearing Shiva's song, and so the Ganga was born. The Lord's body is spiritual, and His "melting" is a manifestation of His love for His devotees' singing, not any loss to Him: Bhaktisiddhanta in his summary understands it as the perspiration that appeared on the Lord's body in ecstasy at the kirtana about Him — that moisture is the Ganga.
  9. I.e. the Ganga is the Lord Himself (Janardana) in the form of sacred water.
  10. When the Lord as Vamana-Trivikrama strode upward, the nail of His foot pierced the shell of the universe, and the waters of the Causal Ocean — the Ganga — poured in; Brahma washed that foot (Bhagavata 5.17.1, 8.21.1–4). Cf. en/19, vv. 119–120.
  11. East Bengal was traditionally "the land the Pandavas avoided" (pandava-varjita): in their wanderings the Pandavas did not visit it, and it was held to be impure. The river Padma (Padmavati) is a branch of the Ganga, but the Ganga's sanctity was not acknowledged for it: "the Ganga and yet not the Ganga".
  12. Damodara — a name of Krishna; cf. v. 86.
  13. Here (vv. 76–86, 86+1 – 86+2) is again Lochana Dasa's motif of nagari-bhava (see en/09, note 9); cf. Murari 1.11.6–10.
  14. I.e. Gaura is Krishna Himself, Radha's Beloved, who has taken on Radha's complexion and mood; so too the Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition understands Him (cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 1.5).
  15. Vv. 86+1 – 86+2 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has them, without brackets.
  16. I.e. the Lord Himself begged people to give Him their sins and take the name of Hari.
